actionable.title: Refresh the tracked-file inventory after tool probes
actionable.problem: The final rescan refreshes workspace files, links and policy hashes, but forbidden_check still comes from the single git ls-files call before probes. A probe that leaves a forbidden path in the Git index while that path is absent from the worktree is therefore not caught by the workspace rescan, and the final receipt reports forbidden_tracked_files.ok=true and required_ok=true. This is a persistent index-only state change, not a file that changed and was restored between checks. Using the existing ReviewBoundaryTests fixture, on_last_probe set case.tracked to ["synthetic-private.key"]; invoke_receipt returned exit code 0, required_ok=true, tool_probes.executed=true, forbidden_tracked_files={"items":[],"ok":true}, and workspace count 0. Only the synthetic mocked listing changed; no real index or dependency tool was used.
actionable.fix: After probes, query git ls-files again and replace the final forbidden_tracked_files check with the refreshed result. Treat a failed second listing as unknown/failure. Preserve tool_probes.executed=true. Add harmless fixture regressions for a persistent forbidden index-only addition and a failed post-probe listing.

actionable.title: Check the elapsed scan budget before returning a clean result
actionable.problem: scan_workspace checks its elapsed budget before processing each entry, but does not check after the final filesystem call or before return. If that last call returns after the 15-second budget, the scan can still return truncated=false, limit=null and no errors, so both preflight and the post-probe receipt may report it as complete. The documented inability to interrupt a blocked OS call does not require this false clean result after the call has returned. A harmless use of the existing WorkspaceBudgetTests fixture, with one existing AGENTS.md entry and a mocked final ismount call that advanced the synthetic clock from 0 to 16, returned a clean scan at a configured limit of 15 seconds.
actionable.fix: Perform a terminal over_budget() check after traversal and internal-link validation, before returning scan results. Add a fake-clock regression for the last filesystem call crossing the elapsed budget and verify the receipt keeps finding counts unknown and required_ok=false.
